title: Origin story: Brigid
description: Brigid was the daughter of the Dagda, goddess of poets, smiths, and healers — three crafts in one divinity. Her sacred flame at Kildare was tended for centuries, and she crossed into sainthood as St. Brigid, her feast of Imbolc marking spring's return.
